calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as transaction_count,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_net_sales,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as atv
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format

-- Verify fiscal period 4 date range
SELECT DISTINCT period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 4

-- Check for data quality issues
SELECT 
  'Negative amounts' as check_type,
  COUNT(*) as count_issues
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
  AND fsl.net_amount < 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Null net_amount',
  COUNT(*)
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
  AND fsl.net_amount IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Null store format',
  COUNT(*)
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
  AND ds.format IS NULL

-- Final result: ATV by store format for period 4 FY2025/26
SELECT 
  ds.format AS store_format,
  ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id), 2) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format
